claim.statement: The publisher's README at tag 1.16.0 describes the default OpenHands CLI confirmation mode as asking for confirmation on each action.

limitations: This exact-version publisher statement was not tested against an installed CLI.
The statement does not enumerate every event that the implementation treats as an action or establish that every consequential side effect is intercepted.
unknowns: The effective confirmation mode of a particular session is unknown.
Confirmation coverage for hooks, MCP tools, subagents, cloud delegation and command side effects was not tested.

relationships.note: The apparent conflict is resolved because always-ask and always-approve are mutually exclusive confirmation configurations.
The apparent conflict is resolved because always-ask and LLM-based approval are mutually exclusive confirmation configurations.
